title: Delivery and Shipping Fee Tariff for Northgate Purchases & Returns Channels
content:
Under Northgate Purchases & Returns a delivery or shipping fee is an order-level charge: it is charged once per order on a channel that has one. The tariff below lists the fee, the order size at which the fee is not charged, and whether a Plus-tier membership presented on the order waives it regardless of order size.

| Channel | Delivery or shipping fee per order (USD) | Pre-tax merchandise total at or above which the fee is not charged (USD) | Plus-tier membership on the order waives the fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Club Purchase | 0.00 | 0.00 (no fee applies) | no |
| Northgate Club Pickup Order | 0.00 | 0.00 (no fee applies) | no |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order | 9.99 | 0.00 (no free-delivery threshold) | no |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 5.99 | 75.00 | yes |
| Northgate Business Delivery Order | 0.00 | 0.00 (no fee applies) | no |
| Northgate Special Order | 0.00 | 0.00 (no fee applies) | no |

### Notes to the tariff

1. A threshold of 0.00 means there is no free-delivery threshold on that channel; it does not mean every order ships free. On the Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order the 9.99 fee is charged on every order, whatever its size, and no Plus-tier waiver applies.
2. On the Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order the 5.99 fee is not charged when the pre-tax merchandise total is 75.00 or more, and it is not charged when a Plus-tier membership is presented on the order, whatever the order size.
3. The four channels with a 0.00 fee charge no delivery or shipping fee.

### Hypothetical tariff readings

| Channel | Pre-tax merchandise total | Plus-tier membership presented | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 74.99 | no | 5.99 |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 75.00 | no | none |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 20.00 | yes | none |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order | 120.00 | yes | 9.99 |
